approach: Greedy Bit Flipping based on place values.
observation: Binary place values decrease from left (most significant bit) to right (least significant bit). Flipping '1' to '0' reduces value by 2^(N-1-i). The earliest '1' maximizes reduction.
bruteForce: Try flipping every bit from 0 to N-1, parse binary strings to numbers and pick the minimum. O(N^2).
optimalSolution: Find the first index i where S[i] == '1' and change it to '0'. If no '1' is found (all '0's), change S[N-1] to '1'. Then convert the resulting string to decimal. Time complexity O(N).
timeComplexity: O(N) single pass through the string.
spaceComplexity: O(N) to store the modified character array.
